Knight_Capital_Group.title: Knight Capital Group
Knight_Capital_Group.extract: Knight Capital Group was an American global financial services firm engaged in market making. On August 1, 2012, a faulty software deployment sent millions of unintended orders to the market in 45 minutes, and the firm lost about $440 million. In 2013 it agreed to pay $12 million to settle charges brought by the SEC.

Enron_scandal.title: Enron scandal
Enron_scandal.extract: The Enron scandal was an accounting scandal at the American energy company Enron. Enron filed for bankruptcy in December 2001, and several of its executives were later convicted.

Barings_Bank.title: Barings Bank
Barings_Bank.extract: Barings Bank was a British merchant bank founded in 1762. It collapsed on 26 February 1995 after losses from unauthorised trading in Singapore.

Archegos_Capital_Management.title: Archegos Capital Management
Archegos_Capital_Management.extract: Archegos Capital Management was an American family office. It collapsed in March 2021 after margin calls on total return swaps, and the banks that lent to it lost more than $10 billion.

Situational_Awareness_LP.title: Situational Awareness LP
Situational_Awareness_LP.extract: Situational Awareness LP is an American hedge fund.

Black_Monday_(1987).title: Black Monday (1987)
Black_Monday_(1987).extract: Black Monday was the global stock market crash of Monday, October 19, 1987, when the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 22.6% in one day.

Example_Lending_Corp.title: Example Lending Corp
Example_Lending_Corp.extract: Example Lending Corp is a made-up lender used in the screener's tests. It collapsed in 2019.
